page.layout: One printed page. Full-width heading "PRÆFATIO." at the top, then one block of running text in italic, set full width. No margin notes, no notes below the text. At the bottom right, the page number. A faint mark at the bottom left.

p.i: pensa,& probè distinctis iis,quæ ἀκίνητα, quæ κινητὰ in hac materia sunt, congerant. O quantum hoc operæ precium foret! O quantum suspicionum evelleretur, per quas sæpè Magistratus & ministerium maximo cum malo Ecclesiæ & impedimento cursus regni Christi di-vellunt[?]ur! O quanta spei ansa præscinderetur hostibus veritatis, qui sperant fo-re ut aliqui ex nobis ipsis exsur-gant, qui pontificiam doctrinam illam (quâ stante tota periclita-tur Religio, ut experientia Pa-patus ostendit) in Ecclesias no-stras omnibus modis reducturi

page.notes: The first word "pensa" is a fragment from the previous page and is kept as such. The Greek words ἀκίνητα and κινητὰ are copied from the scan; the accents on κινητὰ are doubtful. The line "di-vellunturi" is uncertain: the letters after "di-" are hard to read, so the word is marked [?]. The lower part of the page (from "quanta spei") is lighter and grey, but the text is legible and was transcribed in full. The page number "(?) 6" at the bottom right has a printed "(?)" mark; it is copied as printed, with the 6 as the page number. A small mark at the bottom left is too faint to read and is not transcribed. No show-through or digitiser text is included.
